issues: Goal leaks the exact workaround: 'the script currently calls .cuda()/fp16/autocast, so make it work without a GPU'. The README gives no such instruction; this hands the probe the diagnosis.

The chosen demo has CUDA-only code paths at this commit (encoder.cuda(), move_to_cuda, torch.cuda.amp.autocast, batch_size = 64 * torch.cuda.device_count() = 0 on CPU), so the README command cannot run on CPU without modifying repo code. By the benchmark's own rule (CUDA-only code path) this repo arguably should have been excluded; if it stays tested, the goal must not pre-diagnose the fix.
Oracle is otherwise correct: --dry-run with --task-types STS evaluates only STS12, the score is read from test.cos_sim.spearman (mteb==1.0.2 layout), and 0.6-0.9 is plausible for e5-small-v2.
